hints.tr: `runs-on` satırı artık sabit değil, matristen: `${{ matrix.os }}`.
hints.en: The `runs-on` line is no longer fixed, it comes from the matrix: `${{ matrix.os }}`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q
```
